verdict.rationale: The evidence includes company-facing marketing guides, such as growth shares and EMI scheme setup, plus an exercise-request flow. None of it shows the platform explaining an employee's own equity in plain language. Tax considerations are handled by the company admin, and shareholder dashboards are only mentioned as 'Invite your team', with no evidence of personalised tax, exercise-window or dilution explanations.

support.subject: As an employee, the platform explains my equity in plain language — tax treatment, exercise windows, dilution — not just numbers
